craft_notes: Song opens: sthayin utsaha (first vIra song — I-voice exulting). Sanskrit: aham EVA (I INDEED — hammered self) + devaḥ (GOD — self-named as god!) + iti (THUS: stated, sealed). l4.sanskrit_cite: iti śakticakrayantraṃ krīḍāyogena vāhayan devaḥ | aham eva śuddharūpaḥ śaktimahācakranāyakapadasthaḥ

reads_against.l2: Thus driving, by play-discipline, the power-wheel-machine — god: I indeed, pure-formed, standing in the power-great-wheel-lord-seat.
l3: So I drive the wheel of powers in the discipline of play,
pure in form, throned as lord of the mighty wheel.
